rows.note: Use 捉到 as the all-purpose choice for successfully catching or taking a person, especially an enemy or criminal.

example.english: The police finally managed to capture the criminal.
example.traditional: 警方終於捉到個犯人喇。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zung1 jyu1 zuk1 dou2 go3 faan6 jan4 laa3

rows.note: Use 吸引 when something takes hold of or draws someone’s attention, interest, or imagination.

example.english: This movie managed to capture my attention from the very beginning.
example.traditional: 呢套電影一開場就吸引咗我。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 jat1 hoi1 coeng4 zau6 kap1 jan5 zo2 ngo5

rows.note: Use 錄低 when capturing sounds, images, or video so they can be played back later.

example.english: I used my phone to capture the whole lecture.
example.traditional: 我用手機錄低咗成段講座。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 sau2 gei1 luk6 dai1 zo2 seng4 dyun6 gong2 zo6

rows.note: Use 食 specifically when taking an opponent’s piece in chess, go, checkers, or another board game.

example.english: This move can capture his rook.
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 kei4 ho2 ji5 sik6 keoi5 zek3 ce1
